sources.articleTitle: ‘Greatest grief’: Megan Khung’s grandma says case over, but pain will last lifetime

headline: Final Individual Sentenced In Case Of Deceased Child Megan Khung
seoTitle: Final Sentencing In Megan Khung Case
metaDescription: A third person has received a jail sentence in connection to the death of Megan Khung, marking the conclusion of the legal proceedings in the case.
aiSummaryBullets: A final individual has been sentenced to prison for their role in the death of Megan Khung.
The sentencing marks the official conclusion of the legal proceedings regarding the incident.
Family members of the deceased have stated that the legal closure does not diminish their ongoing personal loss.
aiContextParagraph: The legal proceedings concerning the death of Megan Khung have officially concluded following the sentencing of the third and final person involved in the case. The individual received a term of imprisonment for their responsibility in the incident. Family representatives, including the grandmother of the deceased, have acknowledged the resolution of the court process while emphasizing the permanent impact of the loss on their lives. This case has drawn significant public attention and search activity within Singapore as observers followed the judicial outcomes for each of the involved parties. The sentencing signifies the end of the state's prosecution efforts related to the circumstances of Megan Khung's death, though survivors indicate that the emotional toll persists well beyond the final verdict handed down by the court system.
whyItIsViral: The case has generated high search interest in Singapore as the public followed the conclusion of the final legal proceedings.
